tenantId: <Entra ID tenant GUID - Azure portal > Microsoft Entra ID > Overview>
clientId: <Application (client) ID of the public-client app registration used for sign-in>
apiScope: <optional - token scope for deploy.ps1; defaults to https://analysis.windows.net/powerbi/api/.default; set to https://api.fabric.microsoft.com/.default if your tenant requires Fabric-scoped tokens>
repoPath: <optional - local path of the Bitbucket clone containing the PBIP projects, used by deploy.ps1>
defaultBranch: <optional - integration branch of that repo; defaults to main>

environments.name: DEV
environments.workspace: <Power BI workspace name for DEV, as shown in the Power BI service>

environments.name: PROD
environments.workspace: <Power BI workspace name for PROD - the name PROD triggers the confirmation gate>
